title: AI agents are becoming the new storefront, and our store must be ready
summary: Amazon took Alexa for Shopping to 15 countries; OpenAI launched ChatGPT Wallet for agent checkout; Target reports early sales lift from Ask Target. Asus expects the 2027 PC market to shrink 10-15%; Walmart U.S. e-commerce grew 23% in Q3.

points.headline: Agent shopping and payments are now live at scale
points.detail: Alexa for Shopping reached 15 countries, ChatGPT Wallet enables agent checkout and Target sees early gains from Ask Target. We should make our catalog and checkout agent-ready.

points.headline: PC demand is set to weaken as memory costs rise
points.detail: Asus expects the 2027 PC market to shrink 10-15%, notebooks stay weak into Q2 2027 and tablet shipments fell 23%. We should plan promotions, mix and financing for a smaller market.

points.headline: Marketplaces compete on discovery and delivery speed
points.detail: Walmart U.S. e-commerce grew 23% in Q3 on fulfillment speed, and Amazon plans to catalog every product. Our delivery promises and product data must stand out there.

points.headline: Small businesses and value-seeking holiday shoppers drive spending
points.detail: Amex projects a 14-year high in small business holiday spending, while NRF finds affordability shapes holiday shopping. We should lead with business bundles, financing and clear value.
